output.text: The pub quiz night at the old bowls club drew a lively crowd of regulars and newcomers alike. Assume that Gia is the lead volunteer. Esme arrived early to help set up the tables and chairs before the doors opened. Kai showed up a little later, still buzzing from his shift at the bakery, and grabbed a seat near the bar. Ben drove the minibus, bringing along a group of students who had never been to a quiz night before. Gus wandered in soon after, chatting cheerfully with anyone nearby, and quickly found a spot at the back table. Esme and Kai were in different houses, which came up briefly when the quizmaster asked contestants to introduce themselves by team name. Gia, taller than most in the room, carried a stack of answer sheets and a box of pens to distribute to each table. Kai and Gus were in different houses, a fact that surfaced naturally during the icebreaker round about school memories. The quiz itself covered everything from geography to nineties pop music, and the crowd groaned and cheered in equal measure. Esme and Gus were in different houses, though neither seemed to mind since they ended up joking together about a tricky science question. Ben, who had arrived slightly after Esme but before Kai, seemed to know an impressive number of trivia facts about local history. The school had three houses, something an old teacher in attendance mentioned fondly while reminiscing about sports day. By the final round, the room buzzed with anticipation as tables compared scores. Gia handed out the prizes at the end, and everyone agreed it had been one of the best quiz nights the pub had hosted in years.
